title: Features UI polish (review leftovers)
description: Minor/nit findings from the stage B review that were not fixed: (1) the same-column-drop test only fails if BOTH deferred-render flushes (drop and dragend) are removed; (2) dialog.onclose focus return falls back to opener.isConnected, so focus is lost if a poll re-renders the opener (column '+' buttons have no data-fk); (3) the dangling chip's aria-label sits on a plain span with no role (give it role=img or visually hidden text); (4) conflict text says 'Your draft is kept' next to 'Reload current feature', which discards it; (5) feature card polish: the Archived badge stretches to card width, the progress bar is a fixed ~140 px, feature drags have no .dragging/.drop-ok feedback, the card editor's Feature select still shows an archived feature under its normal title; (6) remaining dense one-liners (archive handler, linked-cards list, #ed-feature select, patchFeature validation, filtersActive/clearFilters); (7) tests missing for direct patchFeature without a features/ dir, direct featureColumns shape errors, repeated view toggling, and try/finally around Page.close in the direct creation test.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each item fixed or consciously dropped with a note
